note: Two axes. `failure_mode` cases (E*) run BOTH arms: the with_skill arm is handed the prompt scripts/humanizer.py assembles, the baseline arm is handed nothing in its place, and the difference between them is the measurement. `coverage` cases (G*, S*) run the with_skill arm only: they ask whether the skill behaves correctly on a genre or a style, not whether it beats no skill, and a baseline draw would spend tokens to answer a question the E cases already answer. Grading is deterministic on both axes.
coverage_claim: Every genre in humanizer.GENRE_MAP appears as some case's genre, and every file in references/styles/ is injected by some case -- by the genre-name fallback where the names coincide, by an explicit --style in the S cases. selftest_evals.py TC-EV-45 and TC-EV-46 assert both, so a new genre or a new style file turns the battery red until a case covers it. Four PRESSURE cases (P) and two NATURAL cases (N) were added 2026-09-03: the two open rows of the guide section 11.1 audit. A pressure case carries its own task file under `tasks/`, which reaches BOTH arms; a natural case is copied verbatim from a repository file its key names.
